description: One German railway station as its viafrei.de page shows it: address, step-free platforms now, lifts and escalators (out of service first), platforms, the next departures with live delays, service alerts, parking and charging. Use when asked about a station as a whole: "Was gibt es am Bahnhof Köln Hbf?", "tell me about Leipzig Hbf", "is Hannover Hbf step-free today?". Do NOT use for one lift (check_station_facilities), one train's delay or platform (get_train_departures) or a bus stop (get_departures). Show the attribution line.

departures.description: How many of the next departures to include (0–10, default 10, as many as the station page shows at least). 0 leaves the board out — for "tell me about the station" without trains.

eva_no.description: The station's EVA number (6–8 digits, e.g. 8000207 for Köln Hbf), when a previous result gave you one: exact, no name lookup.

language.description: Set this on every call to the language the person is writing in: "en" if they wrote English, "de" if they wrote German. Do not leave it out: it defaults to German ("de"), which is only the fallback when the language is genuinely unclear, so an English question sent without it is answered in German — a wrong answer. Place names, station names and road numbers are never translated in either language; in English the German term is kept in parentheses so the person recognises it on signs and in local apps.

station.description: The railway station, as the person says it: "Köln Hbf", "Leipzig Hauptbahnhof", "Munich Central". If the name fits several stations, call anyway: the result lists them and asks which. Give either station OR eva_no, never both.

name: describe_station
